children: Bipartisan senators urged Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to give state-regulated stablecoin issuers a safe harbor under the GENIUS Act, saying they need “equal footing” with federal regulators. In a letter, Sens. Cynthia Lummis, Kirsten Gillibrand, Angela Alsobrooks, Pete Ricketts, Kevin Cramer and Mark Warner said Treasury’s proposal protects pending federal applicants if granted a waiver but offers no equivalent to state issuers, according to The Block. The act lets issuers with $10 billion or less choose state oversight if rules are substantially similar; states must certify alignment by January 2028. New York and Wyoming were cited as having comprehensive rules. Some senators raised the issue in June; the OCC’s final rule is set to take effect in January.

title: Senators Press Treasury to Ensure ‘Equal Footing’ for Stablecoin Issuers in GENIUS Act
